displayName: PlanSwap: Claude Code & Codex Account Switcher
description: Switch between your Claude Code and Codex subscription plans (Pro, Max, Plus…) from the sidebar. WSL/Linux and Windows.
command.openTerminal: Run claude in Terminal with Account
command.codex.openTerminal: Run codex in Terminal with Codex Account
command.codex.restartServer: Apply Codex Account: Restart or Show Instructions
command.claude.refreshAllUsage: Refresh Usage Limits of All Claude Accounts
command.codex.refreshAllUsage: Refresh Usage Limits of All Codex Accounts
command.tools.sync: Re-link Accounts to the Default Account
viewContainer.title: PlanSwap
view.name: PlanSwap
config.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language
config.language.description: Language of the PlanSwap panel, status bar and messages. Takes effect immediately. Command titles and other static contributions follow the VS Code display language.
config.usageDisplay.description: Whether usage limit bars and percentages in the sidebar and the status bar show what is left or what is used. Colors and the status bar thresholds always follow what is left.
config.usageAutoRefreshCurrentOnly.descr: Automatic usage checks (planswap.claude.usageAutoRefresh, planswap.codex.usageAutoRefresh) query only the current Claude account and the effective Codex account. When off, the other registered accounts are checked too, one at a time, at the same interval. Manual refreshes are not affected.
config.usageCheckIntervalSeconds.descrip: How often, in seconds, automatic usage checks look for accounts whose refresh interval (planswap.claude.usageRefreshMinutes, planswap.codex.usageRefreshMinutes) has passed (30–600). Only due accounts are queried.
config.sidebarModelLimits.description: Show Claude’s model-specific usage limits in the sidebar. When enabled, they appear below the general limits.
config.sidebarEmail.description: Show the email of each account in the sidebar.
config.sidebarFiveHour.description: Show the 5-hour usage limit of each account in the sidebar.
config.sidebarWeekly.description: Show the 7-day usage limit of each account in the sidebar.
config.claudeUsageAutoRefresh.descriptio: Check the usage limits of the current Claude account automatically (a few seconds after start-up, then while the window is focused once the last check is older than the interval). Manual refreshes always work.
config.claudeUsageRefreshMinutes.descrip: Minutes between automatic usage limit checks of the current Claude account (10–1440).
config.claudeUsageTimeoutSeconds.descrip: Maximum seconds one usage limit check of a Claude account may run before it is ended and reported as timed out (10–120). Applies to automatic and manual checks.
config.codexUsageAutoRefresh.description: Check the usage limits of the effective Codex account automatically (a few seconds after start-up, after a sign-in change, then while the window is focused once the last check is older than the interval). Manual refreshes always work.
config.codexUsageRefreshMinutes.descript: Minutes between automatic usage limit checks of the effective Codex account (5–1440).
config.codexUsageTimeoutSeconds.descript: Maximum seconds one usage limit check of a Codex account may run before it is ended and reported as timed out (5–120). Applies to automatic and manual checks.
config.sidebarWarningThreshold.descripti: A usage limit bar in the sidebar turns to the warning color when the remaining percentage is at or below this value (0–100).
config.sidebarErrorThreshold.description: A usage limit bar in the sidebar turns to the error color when the remaining percentage is at or below this value (0–100). Takes precedence over the warning threshold.
config.statusBarEnabled.description: Show the PlanSwap usage item in the status bar.
config.statusBarProducts.description: Products covered by the status bar item. A product left out is dropped from its text, tooltip and background color; the item is hidden when none of the selected products is set up.
config.statusBarWarningThreshold.descrip: The status bar item gets the warning background when the lowest remaining percentage of the shown products’ general usage limits is at or below this value (0–100).
config.statusBarErrorThreshold.descripti: The status bar item gets the error background when the lowest remaining percentage of the shown products’ general usage limits is at or below this value (0–100). Takes precedence over the warning threshold.
config.statusBarAlignment.description: Side of the status bar the PlanSwap item sits on.
config.statusBarAlignment.left: Left side of the status bar
config.statusBarAlignment.right: Right side of the status bar
config.claudeConfirmSwitch.description: Ask for confirmation before switching Claude accounts from the sidebar (switch button, double-click or Enter). Codex switching always asks. When off, double-click or Enter on a focused row switches at once.
